description: A global teardown that throws after a passing run (T9.15): the reporters' summary comes first (onRunComplete runs inside scheduleTests; runGlobalHook(globalTeardown) follows it), then the CLI prints the error, whose message Jest has rewritten (`Jest: Got error running globalTeardown - <path>, reason: <message>`), and the exit code is 1 though every test passed. The black-box run captures the exit code and the summary's totals lines with the error's own.
